name: A_numbers_first
lines: At least three and a half million people.
And a coin with no real blockchain behind it.
So how do you sell millions of people a coin that never existed?
This is the story of OneCoin, told through one saver who believed in it.

name: B_flight_question
lines: On October twenty-fifth, twenty seventeen, a woman boarded a flight from Sofia to Athens.
Five years later, she was on the F.B.I.'s Ten Most Wanted list.
Her company, OneCoin, had taken in more than four billion dollars.
This is how she did it, and who paid for it.

name: C_second_person
lines: What if the coin you bought never existed?
For at least three and a half million people, that was OneCoin.
Together they handed over more than four billion dollars.
Then its founder boarded a flight from Sofia to Athens, and vanished.
This is how the scam worked, and why so many believed it.
